stage6CloseoutTestCommit.reasoning: expected_history already contains the replay projection and no longer carries erased raw bytes. Detecting every sanitizer collision without a raw authority would require changing the contract to preserve a universal raw representation or comparing unlike raw/projected strings, which would reintroduce B-1 and make legitimate retry/rewind histories such as trailing-newline projection differences fail forever. The no-sidecar acceptance pin documents that forced information limit; the companion api_content case pins the available exact-byte compensation. On replay the erased span is also absent from model-visible history, so the residual exposure is durable-record/export fidelity rather than model behavior.
